pages.text: Nutrition is handled by the $(l)RP Culinary$() mod: satiety in calories, water, protein, fat, carbs, vitamins and body weight. Key $(l)K$() — how you feel.

How nutrition affects the body:$(br)- Low protein — slow healing, weaker hits.$(br)- Low fat — chilly.$(br)- Low carbs — no energy.$(br)- Low vitamins — sick more often.$(br)- Balanced — better healing and immunity.$(br2)Exact values — only by a blood test.

$(l)Hunger$() does not kill: first weakness, then hunger faints. The hungry heal worse. $(l)Dehydration$() lowers blood volume and pressure.$(br2)Those who cannot eat — $(l)IV feeding$() on the drip stand (see "IV stand").
